violation_type.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Meal and Snack Schedule (26 TAC §746.3303)
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Meal and Snack Schedule
violation_type.typical_finding: Due to the food program requirements, there needs to be many changes to the snack calendar to replace grain based desserts and desserts to food with less added sugar more whole grains. Foods needing tobe replaced would be: apple, cinnimon straws, taco puffs, veggie straws, pirates booty, vanilla wafers, nutrigrain bars.

finding_variants.text: Due to the food program requirements, there needs to be many changes to the snack calendar to replace grain based desserts and desserts to food with less added sugar more whole grains. Foods needing tobe replaced would be: apple, cinnimon straws, taco puffs, veggie straws, pirates booty, vanilla wafers, nutrigrain bars.
Based on information gathered during the inspection, children in care went more than 3 hours without a meal or snack.
